annotation.title_clean: Stratégie nationale d'intelligence artificielle du Canada : L'IA pour tous
annotation.title_en: Canada's National Artificial Intelligence Strategy: AI for All
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Innovation, Sciences et Développement économique Canada (ISDE)
annotation.venue: Innovation, Sciences and Economic Development Canada
annotation.summary_en: Canada's 2026 national AI strategy, "AI for All," sets six pillars: protecting Canadians and democracy, empowering people, driving adoption, building sovereign AI foundations, scaling Canadian champions, and trusted international partnerships. It centres on trust, opportunity and sovereignty, with a target of 60% business AI adoption by 2034. It has no robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Six pillars: protect Canadians, empower people, adoption, sovereign AI foundations, Canadian champions, international alliances
Target: 60% of Canadian businesses, especially SMEs, adopting AI tools by 2034
Government to act as anchor adopter of trusted Canadian AI
Trust is the 'North Star'; strategy to be reviewed and updated continuously
Based on 11,000+ consultation contributions and a 28-expert task force
